$comment: Hand-written; make helm-generate preserves it. Constrains only what the generated templates and Helm's value merge cannot express, and leaves every other value unchecked.

extraArgs.$comment: Helm cannot merge a list into the chart's map of flags: the list replaces it and drops --txt-wildcard-replacement=wildcard, with only a warning. Overrides must be a map, which merges by key.
